This is basically how it was handled last year, except they are splitting Deal and Portfolio. Regarding Analysts - we need to provide them the bonus targets rather than Compensation Committee just deciding. Regarding support staff - again, we need to provide the targets (as we discussed earlier this week).

The biggest issue we have is how to use Workday and avoid the manual excel spreadsheet-Workday-excel spreadsheet exercise we went through last year. We are working with Hannah Ferguson and the Workday team on this.

Managing Directors have to go through the final firm-wide Charlotte review, so that is one more step for the MDs and the compensation committee meeting outcome should be consistent with how all are rated going into the final meeting (ie., 10/80/10, 1-100).

Jennifer

From: Davis, Matthew
Sent: Tuesday, October 14, 2025 1:17 PM
To: Smith, Brandy
Subject:

Here is our plan on Charlotte.

Analysts:

Ranked 1,2,3 by supervisors - pay determined by Me and Brandy. No meetings.

Support Staff but in Deal Team:

Traditional ranking with the correct people attending the meetings. Pay grid determined by Compensation Committee.

Associates and Senior Associates

Ranked as per Cameron Lemmons %'s and then pay grid determined by Compensation Committee. I would like to see 25% - 65% - 10%. Cameron disagrees. This would provide for a quick meeting rather than trying to split them into 4 groups with the top one excluding some awesome people.

Directors/Senior Directors

Ranked from 1 to 100 in as many clusters as the groups see fit. We are going to combine directors and senior directors into one table. The ranking is based on this years performance is directly related to pay. We will have two meetings - one for portfolio and one for other commercial staff (origination/finance/etc). We will not have a pay committee but will take the results of the rankings and work with individual leaders after the meetings to ensure the appropriate compensation.

We will also determine promotions during this meeting using different criteria.

Managing Directors

We will rank all our MDs from 1 to 100 with a group of selected people - some MDs and some Partners.
This too will be directly related to pay.

Cheers as you Brits say
